Heard the parties.
2.

Present writ petition has been filed by the petitioner(s) for the following relief(s):-
"A. For quashing of letter as contained in memo no. 277 dated 23.10.2010,
(Annexure-4) issued under the signature of Special Land Acquisition no. 1,
Swarnrekha Project whereby and where under the authority has declined to make payment for the land bearing Khata no. 33, Khesra no. 628, area about 0.78 acre (for Petitioner no. 1).

B. To make payment of the Petitioners' Land acquired by the Authorities for construction of Swarnrekha Project (without acquisition procedure) of Thana no. 205, Khata No. 33, Khesra No. 628, area about 0.78 acre (for the Petitioner no. 1), Thana no. 205, Khata no. 251, Khesra 551, area about 1.37 acres (for petitioner no.
2), Thana no. 205, Khata no. 110, Khesra no. 586, 587, 597, 598 and 606, area about 1.37 acres, 0.93 acres, 0.92 acres, 0.09 acre and 1.22 acre, total area 4.53 acre (for the Petitioner no. 3) and Thana no. 205, Khata no. 104 &105, Khesra no. 535 & 624, area about 2.61 acre & 0.31 acre (for the Petitioner no. 4), more so as per the report submitted by the Anchal Ameen, Chandil the land in question of Petitioners are being used for Swarnrekha Project."
3. A counter affidavit has been filed by the State.

Paragraph Nos. 8 to 11 of the counter affidavit are reproduced hereinbelow:-
8.

That it is further stated and submitted that regarding the claim of the petitioners requisition officer of SMP, i.e Executive Engineer, Subernarekha Dam Division No.-2,
Chandil has submitted requisition plan for acquire the land of the petitioners as well as other villagers effected land vide letter no.-286 dt. 25-03-2022.
9.

That as per requisition plan in spot verification office found, total raiyati land 51.58 acres have been passed and notified under section- 11(1) of The right to fair compensation and transparency to land acquisition rehabilitation act-2013 vide memo no. 161 date 05-07- 2022.

10. That it is further stated and submitted that it is necessary to mention here that after completion of L.A proceeding payment of compensation should be made to the petitioners as well as other effected raiyati accordingly.

A Photocopy of Letter no.-286 & 161 are being annexed as Annexure A &
B respectively to the Counter Affidavit.

sentences.text: That with regard to the statements made in paragraph-2, 4, 5, 7, 8, 13, 18, 32, 33 and 34 of the writ petition under reply, it is stated and submitted that the same require no comment.

4. In view of the fact that the respondent(s) authorities have admitted that the construction has been made without acquisition and further they have proposed for acquiring the land by initiating a proper acquisition proceeding.
5.

In view of the above specific statements made by the respondent(s) in his/their counter affidavit,
present writ petition stands disposed of, directing the respondent(s) either to complete the acquisition proceeding within six months from the date of receipt/production of a copy of this order or to remove the structure built up therein without making acquisition.
